name: Necromancer Unstoppable Frenzy shortens Unholy Frenzy's cooldown by 60 sec (#1335)
contract: Unstoppable Frenzy 573426 is an Animation talent (CharacterAdvancement 33773, ClassType 25 = class 23, Tab Animation, TalentEssenceCost 1, SpellFamilyName 29) whose description reads 'Reduces the cooldown of your Unholy Frenzy by $/1000;s1 sec.' Its only effect is SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107) MiscValue 11 (SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN), BasePoints -60001 + DieSides 1 = -60000 ms, EffectSpellClassMask (0, 0, 0x100000) in family 29, which matches Unholy Frenzy 805029 (family flags 0, 0, 0x100000; RecoveryTime 180000, no category cooldown, no SpellCharges row, description 'Enrage your Undead minions for $d ...'). It is not aura 42/354, so the Necromancer load contract leaves it intact, and Player::AddSpellAndCategoryCooldowns applies the caster's SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN to RecoveryTime. Expected: an Unholy Frenzy cast starts a 180 sec cooldown without the talent and a 120 sec cooldown with it.

steps.label: CONTROL: the untalented cooldown is 180 sec
The native cooldown modifier removes 60 sec
SETUP: Unholy Frenzy is ready again
DISCRIMINATING: the talented cooldown is 120 sec
